mechanism: Propylthiouracil can cause agranulocytosis and immunosuppression, which may be exacerbated by anticholinergic effects of scopolamine on mucosal immunity and salivary flow; additive anticholinergic effects may occur.
action: Monitor for signs of infection, maintain adequate hydration and oral care; use lowest effective scopolamine dose and consider alternative anticholinergic if prolonged use needed.
